notes.title: The EMPYRE Trilogy is Complete!
notes.notes:
We are beyond thrilled to announce that we have done it! The Trilogy is finished! Now you can explore three unique settings all in different eras of the EMPYRE Universe. 

Have a taste for what the future may hold? Try living in a drowned city for a spell! That would be Lord of the Sea Gates. https://store.steampowered.com/app/696810/EMPYRE_Lords_of_the_Sea_Gates/

In the mood for cowboys and robots? Head on over to the city in the sky for a wild ride! Buckle up in Dukes of the Far Frontier. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1935460/EMPYRE_Dukes_of_the_Far_Frontier/

If spiritual enlightenment is more your thing, the Orient awaits for your journey into the sublime.  Look within in Earls of the Deep Earth. https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649500/EMPYRE_Earls_of_the_Deep_Earth/
